title: anneal plan
description: A plan as `anneal lint plan` reads it from a markdown plan written from playbooks/plan.template.md: the `data.plan` of its envelope. The markdown is the source; this is its structure.

spec.description: The spec the plan's `Spec:` line links, relative to the plan's directory; null when there is none (a lint finding).

tasks.description: The tasks under `## Tasks`, in file order, each id once; at most the first 1,000 (`data.tasks` counts every task read, and `data.omitted_tasks` the ones left out).

files.description: The files the task's `Files:` line names in backticks.

test.description: The command the task's `Test:` line names in backticks; null when there is none (a lint finding).

blocked_by.description: The ids of the tasks this one waits for; empty for `Blocked by: none`.
